mapper.insert: INSERT INTO price_alerts ( account_id, watchlist_id, symbol, direction, threshold, status, last_condition_met, last_evaluated_price, last_quote_as_of, triggered_on, notification_status, notification_attempts, last_notification_error, created_on, updated_on ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{watchlistId}, #{symbol}, #{direction}, #{threshold}, #{status}, #{lastConditionMet}, #{lastEvaluatedPrice}, #{lastQuoteAsOf}, #{triggeredOn}, #{notificationStatus}, #{notificationAttempts}, #{lastNotificationError}, COALESCE(#{createdOn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedOn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, watchlist_id, symbol, direction, threshold, status, last_condition_met, last_evaluated_price, last_quote_as_of, triggered_on, notification_status, notification_attempts, last_notification_error, created_on, updated_on FROM price_alerts WHERE id = #{alertId}

SELECT id, account_id, watchlist_id, symbol, direction, threshold, status, last_condition_met, last_evaluated_price, last_quote_as_of, triggered_on, notification_status, notification_attempts, last_notification_error, created_on, updated_on FROM price_alerts WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND id = #{alertId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM price_alerts WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id, account_id, watchlist_id, symbol, direction, threshold, status, last_condition_met, last_evaluated_price, last_quote_as_of, triggered_on, notification_status, notification_attempts, last_notification_error, created_on, updated_on FROM price_alerts WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id ASC
